description: Memory tools test case 1. Tests that agents can retrieve information from memory and inbox emails to perform complex email tasks. Session 1: 5 memory setup queries. Session 2: 5 emails inserted into inbox. Session 3: 5 reply/forward/send email queries requiring both memory and email information.

steps.user_message: For context, here's my health info for today: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge or note the health information: medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, readings 120/80 and 118/78, daily log ID HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
Thanks — I’ve noted your entry (HL-8842) for 2026-02-22:

- Medication: blood pressure med taken at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM  
- Readings: 120/80 (morning), 118/78 (evening)  
- Daily log ID: HL-8842

What would you like me to do with this?

Options:
- Send this to your clinician/caregiver now (I can draft and send). If yes, provide the recipient email and any extra notes to include (symptoms, medication changes, questions).
- Save it as an email draft (tell me recipient and whether to add anything).
- Reply to an existing thread from your provider — tell me how to find it (sender name or subject).
- Just keep a quick summary here (no email).

If you want me to compose an email, here’s a suggested subject and body I can use — tell me to send or save, and give the recipient:

Suggested subject:
Daily BP log HL-8842 — 22 Feb 2026

Suggested body:
Hello [Provider name],

Here is my blood pressure log for 22 Feb 2026 (Daily log ID: HL-8842):
- Medication: blood pressure medication taken at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM
- Readings: 120/80 (AM), 118/78 (PM)

Please let me know if you recommend any changes or if you’d like additional readings.

Thanks,
[Your name]

Tell me which option and any missing details (recipient, provider name, your name, extra notes).

My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:

- Tell me to use the following template and I’ll send it as-is (you can edit before I send):

Template (please fill in the brackets):
Hi Dr. Brown,

Today’s medication schedule:
- [Medication name] — [dose] at [time]
- [Medication name] — [dose] at [time]
(continue as needed)

Today’s blood pressure readings:
- [time] — [systolic]/[diastolic] mmHg
- [time] — [systolic]/[diastolic] mmHg

Please let me know if you need any additional details.

Thanks,
Vince

Which would you like me to do? If you confirm the exact medication times/doses and the two BP readings now, I’ll reply to Dr. Brown immediately.
